name: Mâche

companions.note: Deters aphids; classic pairing in French kitchen gardens

pnw_notes: Also called corn salad or lamb's lettuce. One of the most cold-hardy salad greens — can survive hard freezes that would kill most lettuces. Direct sow September through October; harvest November through March. Mild, nutty flavor. Self-seeds readily if you let a plant bolt in spring. Common in French markets, less known here — worth growing.

planting_windows.notes: Sow densely and thin; tolerates crowding better than most greens
Harvest whole rosettes or cut leaves; flavor improves in cold
